stock-dazed-sliding-volley.head: ff271e8f
stock-dazed-sliding-volley.scope: The stock level-22 route used the Dazed interlock opponent, played 21081 and observed 85 and 76 after armor. It demonstrated the natural ten-second Enraged and Withdraw recovery. Executable miss cases cover the ordinary style fallback, with the shared stock presentation from PR914.

damage.source: GOB 249 stores fixed Ballistic base 77 for the successful Dual SMG attack.
damage.runtime: The normal selected opponent receives the Ballistic hit with current style and linked influence and their own typed resistance.
damage.test: SlidingVolleyLandsItsFixedBaseThroughTheLevel22BallisticPath tests the exact level-22 profile. Stock observed 85 neutral and raw85/final76 through source1061 stat181 +20. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632

controls.source: GOB 249 gives Enraged for 10 s after a landed 20% roll. The Enraged condition blocks Withdraw.
controls.runtime: The ordinary conditional state adds paired source249/93 and 93 records, applies its action gate, and retires both records with one state-end.
controls.test: The stock eighth landed attempt produced records 292/293 for ten seconds. The same 0x44 action was refused during Enraged and accepted after both records ended. No unrelated immunity was applied. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632

targeting.source: The shipped move is restricted to its Dazed interlock opponent with a compatible dual-SMG weapon.
targeting.runtime: The ordinary request binds the selected live spawn and fight, and the queued side preserves that identity when a round resolves.
targeting.test: SlidingVolleyQueuesOnlyOnTheDazedCurrentOpponent and SlidingVolleyCannotTransferToANewOpponentOrRespawn cover style, weapon, load, stale opponent and replacement. The stock client stopped both its rest and undazed requests before transmit, then admitted the Dazed opponent. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632

proc.source: GOB 249 stores the separate landed Enraged probability 20% and a fixed ten-second duration.
proc.runtime: TimedEffects evaluates the stored roll for the bound recipient and uses shared state retirement.
proc.test: GunControlsRespectTheirStoredProbabilityAtLanding tests both sides of the cutoff. Stock witnessed a natural activation after repeated eligible hits and retained the paired expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632

choreography.source: The shipped landed move is 21081. An unsuccessful queue result follows the ordinary style exchange.
choreography.runtime: The ordinary round selects 21081 on a successful 249 and resolves a miss or counter with its matching style exchange.
choreography.test: Stock saw the 21081 hit. SlidingVolleyNormalMissKeepsTheOrdinaryRoundWithoutSpecialDamage checks both no-hit and opponent-hit variants. PR914 stock verified the shared ordinary dual-SMG fallback. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/914#issuecomment-7092713226 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632

source-parity.source: GOB 249 supplies 15 IS, 10/5 s own/group 689 reuse, +24 tactic, fixed 77 Ballistic, Dazed admission, 21081 and the landed Enraged roll.
source-parity.runtime: The selected interlock route applies the GOB +24 once as a flat adjustment and consumes the typed damage and effect. The original tacticalValue producer remains qualified in the common gun-special policy.
source-parity.test: Native saw base28→52, 15 IS, the two timers, 21081 and both typed results, condition gates and natural Enraged/Withdraw lifecycle. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632

behavior-tests.source: The authored input includes the selected Daze state, equipment, timed reuse, normal interlock exchange and state proc.
behavior-tests.runtime: Ordinary cast admission and same-fight queueing lead to a typed landed hit or ordinary fallback, followed by conditional state and action gating.
behavior-tests.test: The request, fight-replacement, direct typed hit, ordinary miss and fixed-probability regressions complement the actual native runs for interlock, cost/reuse, armor and Enraged. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/916#issuecomment-7093182632
